# Project Memory

## 2026-05-17: Cross-Family Pooled IRT v4 Results

### Data Completeness
- Llama-3.2-3B signals: ALL complete at `/root/autodl-tmp/exp002/signals/Llama-3.2-3B_d{000,005,025,100}_s42/`
- Each has: s1 (embedding), s2 (minkpp), s4 (selfcritique) × 3 benchmarks (mmlu, gsm8k, arc) + merged
- **Known issues**: Llama d000 MMLU alignment missing (item_responses has 0 MMLU items despite 45.4% raw accuracy); Llama d100 MMLU degenerate (all predictions = A)

### Cross-Family Pooled IRT v4 (2PL+gamma, Qwen+Llama)
Output: `/root/autodl-tmp/exp006/cross_family_v4/`

| Benchmark | N | gamma | 95% CI | Significant | PPP | calMAE |
|-----------|---|-------|--------|-------------|-----|--------|
| MMLU | 18 | 0.4148 | [-0.60, 1.41] | NO | 0.596 | 0.008 |
| GSM8K | 28 | -0.1099 | [-0.52, 0.28] | NO | 0.832 | 0.008 |
| ARC | 20 | 0.0016 | [-0.57, 0.60] | NO | 0.449 | 0.015 |

### Comparison with Qwen-only (exp_006_pooled_2pl_gamma_qwen_n24)

| Benchmark | Qwen N | Qwen gamma | Cross-family N | Cross-family gamma |
|-----------|--------|------------|----------------|-------------------|
| MMLU | 16 | 0.66 [-0.41, 1.74] | 18 | 0.41 [-0.60, 1.41] |
| GSM8K | 24 | 0.06 [-0.36, 0.49] | 28 | -0.11 [-0.52, 0.28] |
| ARC | 16 | **0.73 [0.02, 1.44] SIG** | 20 | 0.00 [-0.57, 0.60] |

### Key Finding
Adding Llama-3.2-3B to the pooled IRT **diluted** the gamma signal rather than strengthening it:
- ARC lost its marginal significance (Qwen-only gamma=0.73, CI excludes zero → cross-family gamma≈0)
- MMLU gamma decreased from 0.66 to 0.41
- GSM8K gamma flipped sign (-0.11)

**Interpretation**: Llama and Qwen may have fundamentally different contamination-exposure relationships. A single pooled gamma across model families is not appropriate. This supports family-stratified IRT rather than cross-family pooling.

### Exclusions Applied (v4)
- D045: 0.5B excluded from MMLU and ARC
- MMLU model-level: Llama d000 (no aligned data), Llama d100 (degenerate)
- Dosage balance: GSM8K 7/7/7/7, ARC 5/5/5/5, MMLU 4/5/5/4
